text:
Predicates:
ArtificiallySelected(x) ::: x is artificially selected.
HeckCattle(x) ::: x is Heck cattle.
Resembles(x, y) ::: x resembles y.
Extinct(y) ::: y is extinct.
Premises:
BreedingBack is a form of artificial selection ::: (BreedingBack → ArtificiallySelected(x))
HeckCattle(x) ∧ BredBack(x, y) ∧ Year(y, 1920) ::: Heck cattle were bred-back in the 1920s.
HeckCattle(x) ::: Heck cattle are animals.
Aurochs(y) ::: Aurochs are animals.
Some animals to be bred-back resemble animals that are extinct ::: ∃x ∃y (Animal(x) ∧ BredBack(x, y) ∧ Extinct(y))
Conclusion:
∃x (HeckCattle(x) ∧ ArtificiallySelected(x)) ::: Some Heck cattle are artificially selected.
